title: Momoi Airi — Featuring My Melody〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so glad today's event went well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've gotta keep up the good work so even more people get to know us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still... My Mel really was amazing.
The way she talked and her dancing were so cute it felt unfair.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh... That reminds me, I bought those My Mel cookies as a souvenir.
Maybe I'll try some.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I thought I heard singing just now...
Was it coming from my phone?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I definitely hear it.
That's odd, nothing should be playing... Are Miku and the others putting on a show or something?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll drop in to take a look.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh? Nobody's here...
Then, that voice was...
Hmmmhmhm, hmmm♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... It sounds like it's coming from this ball of light.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What is this?
It feels like I've seen it somewhere before...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And this voice, could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wha... Huh?!
Where am I?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was in SEKAI until just a second ago, wasn't I...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Those people over there... Is that Minori and the others?!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Oh! Airiii!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So you're here too, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. And just where is here...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We just arrived as well...
But we were just talking about how it feels a bit like Puroland.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... Now that you mention it, it does...
Hm hmhm hmhmmm♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did you hear a voice just now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I did. I was following this voice when I somehow ended up here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We might be able to get some ideas for how to get home, so let's head toward the voice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Over there, that's...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My Mel?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd thought just maybe it could be her, but to think that she's actually here...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But what is she doing?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This is just a guess, but... Don't you think she's making cookies?
Look, she's got some sort of dough under a roller.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're right. Plus... Doesn't this place remind you of the stage where we did that event with her?
Even the set is identical.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It is...!
What does it all mean...?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Hmmmhm, hmmm♪
Extend... Pull back. Rolly rolly roll...

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Phew... I sure am tired.
Time to take a little break♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like she's having a hard time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, everyone. Why don't we go help My Mel?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I don't think I'll be able to leave her to it...
And while we're at it, let's see if she knows anything about this place she can share.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Heeey, My Meeel!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Phew...
Now we just wait for them to bake in the oven♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Thanks for helping me, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
There's no need to thank us.
I like making treats too, so this was fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And thank you for telling us about this place, My Mel.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You said this is a SEKAI born from the feelings of wanting to visit Puroland again and thinking about how fun it was, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If that's the case, I can certainly understand why it resembles Puroland so much.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone. Would you like to have a tea party while we wait for the cookies to bake?
I have some really yummy tea♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That would be lovely! We got this chance to meet, so let's have a nice long chat!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Okay, here you are♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Wow, it smells so good!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, My Mel, why were you baking cookies?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: So I can give them to my precious friend♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: So, I handed out the cookies to all my friends the other day... But I was short one for her, so she and I had to split one.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: That's why I'm making lots and lots this time, so she can eat her fill!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So that's why...
You care for your friends very much, My Mel.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Oh... But, I've always loved to bake cookies.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: My dream is to get much, much better so I can open a dessert shop and make everybody happy with my treats.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. That's a truly wonderful dream.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Thank you♪
What are your dreams?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're working really hard to become idols who give people hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Wow, what a wonderful dream.
I'll be cheering for you!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: You're all so cute and dazzling, so I think you'll be able to give people lots of hope♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe, thank you.
But I think you're also very cute and dazzling, My Mel.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Am I?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I think so too!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Hehehe...♪

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: So cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Th-This is against the rules...!)

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: They're finished!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad they appear to have come out well.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Yeah♪ Now to give them a taste.
*Blow*
*Munch*

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line:
Wow, it's so delicious♪
Here everyone, you should try them too♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll have one.
Oh, this really is delicious! I'm sure your friend will be delighted.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Actually, Airi, you kind of remind me of my friend.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I do?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Mhm. She's super sweet, just like you♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, well thank you!
I'm happy to hear you say that.

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Hey, I want to talk with all of you some more, so... How about we have another tea party, with cookies this time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
But didn't you say these cookies are for your friend?

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: There's a whooole lot, so it'll be okay if we eat a little bit♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well then, I think we'd like to take you up on that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I want to talk with you more too, My Mel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Tell us lots about your friend, too!

rows.Speaker: My Melody
rows.Line: Okay♪
